extracted.intended_audience: Principal Investigators, program directors, and key personnel preparing NIH PHS 398 / Research & Related grant application materials (biosketches and budgets), including SBIR applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing NIH PHS 398-format biographical sketches and Research & Related budgets for grant applications (including SBIR/R01-style submissions). Covers required biosketch sections, education/training fields, research support entries, and detailed budget categories and justifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch - format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The biosketch must follow the specified format for each person and must not exceed four pages. The form organizes content into labeled subsections (A–D).

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal Statement (section A) describing the individual's qualifications, training, and relevance to the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how your training and experience qualify you for the proposed role (examples in the document include clinical responsibilities, prior diagnostic-development work, and relevant degrees such as MHS). Indicate the role you will play (e.g., co-investigator) and connect prior work to the proposed project aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors / Positions and Employment
rubrics_metrics.description: List Positions and Employment and Academic Honors (chronological entries showing dates and role titles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a chronological list of positions and employment with years and institutions. Include academic honors and professional society memberships in this section or adjacent honors subsection as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Selected Peer-Reviewed Publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Selected peer-reviewed publications relevant to the field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a curated list of publications with full citations (examples show journal, year, volume, pages). The example shows '15 of 15 with relevance to the field' but does not prescribe a strict maximum beyond the overall page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support (Current and Completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Document current and completed research support including award number, project title, dates, total amount, and role (PI, co-investigator, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List each support entry with sponsor, grant/contract number, project title, project dates, dollar amount, and the individual's role (e.g., Principal Investigator, Co-Investigator). Separate current and completed support. Examples include NIH R01, NIAID U01, CDC projects, and industry-sponsored trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training block
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable.) Provide institution and location, degree (if applicable), year(s), and field of study.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each training entry include institution/location, degree, dates (MM/YY or years), and field of study. Begin with undergraduate (baccalaureate) and continue through terminal degrees and postgraduate training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Senior/Key Person (Section A fields)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each Senior/Key Person list Project Role; Cal. Months; Acad. Months; Sum. Months; Base Salary ($); Requested Salary ($); Fringe Benefits ($); Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the specified columns for each senior/key person in Section A of the Research & Related Budget. Ensure arithmetic consistency across months and salary columns and include fringe benefit amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Other Personnel (Section B)
rubrics_metrics.description: List number of personnel by category (Postdoctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical), project roles, months (cal., acad., sum.), requested salary, fringe benefits, and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide counts and budget lines for each personnel category, with months and dollar figures. Total other personnel and total salary/wages + fringe must be computed for Section B.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment (Section C) — threshold and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Equipment Description — List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any single equipment item > $5,000 must be listed with item description and cost. Provide totals for equipment requested. Follow period-specific equipment entries (Year 1, Year 2, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel (Section D) — domestic and foreign
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Travel — Separate Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico and U.S. Possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs; provide totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget domestic and foreign travel on separate lines and provide cost breakout and totals in the appropriate budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee Support Costs (Section E)
rubrics_metrics.description: E. Participant/Trainee Support Costs — include Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other, and Number of Participants/Trainees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide detailed participant/trainee support lines and compute totals for Section E. List number of participants and itemize support categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs (Section F) — required categories
rubrics_metrics.description: F. Other Direct Costs — Materials and Supplies; Publication Costs; Consultant Services; ADP/Computer Services; Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; Alterations and Renovations; etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize other direct cost categories and provide dollar amounts for each. Include subaward/consortium costs separately and provide necessary attachments describing subaward budgets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct, Indirect Costs, Total Costs, Fee and Indirect Cost reporting (Sections G–J)
rubrics_metrics.description: G. Direct Costs (total A–F); H. Indirect Costs — Indirect Cost Rate (%) and Indirect Cost Base ($) and Cognizant Federal Agency; I. Total Direct and Indirect Costs; J. Fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report indirect cost rate and base, identify the cognizant federal agency, compute totals (G + H), and include any fee if applicable. Ensure consistent bases and rates and provide supporting documentation as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification (Section K and narrative)
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget Justification — narrative explanation of personnel effort, roles, institutional contributions, and items not charged to the grant (e.g., organizational in-kind contributions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each named person include percent effort (%FTE), calendar months, role description, and specific responsibilities. Describe how many instruments or resources are supplied by the organization at no cost, planned number of consumables (e.g., FilmArray pouches) contributed internally, and rationale for requested supplies and other direct costs. Provide periodized effort and cost justification (e.g., Year 1 vs Year 2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Periodization and Cumulative Budgeting
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide budgets by budget period (e.g., Budget Period 1, Budget Period 2) and a Cumulative Budget summary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter start and end dates for each budget period, show period-specific details (A–K) for each year/period, and summarize cumulative totals across periods. Include attachments where requested for multiple periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative/organizational identifiers and form fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Organizational DUNS, Budget Type, Enter name of Organization, Start Date, End Date, Project Subaward/Consortium details, and Tracking/Funding Opportunity Number fields as required on the form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete administrative metadata such as DUNS, budget type (project/subaward), organization name, project start/end dates, and funding opportunity/tracking numbers. Attach required files and contact information for the agency POC when specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form attachments and file handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach only one file where requested (e.g., budget justification attachment) and use provided 'Add Attachment'/'Delete Attachment' controls per budget period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the form's attachment instructions (single file for some items), keep attachments labeled by budget period, and include supporting documents such as detailed subaward budgets or budget justification PDFs.
